d: In aninteraction with The Hindu, Indian tennis icon and veteran broadcaster Vijay Amritraj shared his perspective on the extraordinary traits that define tennis legends across eras. Describing Roger Federer’s game as a lesson of grace in motion akin to a ballet dancer, Amritraj also looked back at his own playing days, picking Ilie Nastase and John McEnroe as the most naturally gifted talents he ever faced.
